environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind a basic TCP load balancer (NLB). No reverse proxy, no header injection middleware. Service listens directly on port 8080 with traffic forwarded from NLB port 443 after TLS termination. No request validation layer. IAM instance profile has no restrictions on the application behavior.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough after TLS termination)
